Heading 1 — “Setup and Storage” (level 1)
Promise: Covers both product setup and storage guidance.
Supporting content: “Connect the cable before use.” This supports one setup step. The nested section supplies storage-temperature guidance: “Store the unit between 10°C and 20°C.”
Coverage status: Partially covered. The required topic, storage temperature, is covered by the protected subsection. The broader setup-and-storage promise is not fully supported.
Missing elements: Additional setup information implied by “Setup,” such as where or how to connect the cable; general storage guidance implied by “Storage,” if broader guidance is intended.
Overbreadth: Yes. The heading promises two broad subjects, while the document provides only one connection instruction and one temperature constraint.
Protection: Not protected.
Bounded repair options: (1) Narrow it to “Cable Connection and Storage Temperature”; (2) split it into separate setup and storage sections; or (3) retain it and add only the setup and storage instructions necessary to fulfill its scope. Do not invent missing procedures or conditions.

Heading 1.1 — “Storage Temperature” (level 2)
Promise: States the permitted or recommended temperature range for storage.
Supporting content: “Store the unit between 10°C and 20°C.”
Coverage status: Fully covered for the required topic. The content directly supplies a storage-temperature range.
Missing elements: None required by the stated topic. Units and lower and upper bounds are present. Whether endpoints are inclusive is not explicitly stated; “between” may be ambiguous if exact boundary treatment matters.
Overbreadth: None. The heading is narrower than and accurately matched by the content.
Protection: Protected; preserve exactly as “Storage Temperature.”
Bounded repair options: Keep the heading unchanged. Optionally clarify endpoint inclusivity in the content if authoritative information exists, for example by replacing “between” with approved inclusive/exclusive wording. Do not alter the protected heading or invent tolerances, humidity limits, durations, or operating-temperature requirements.
